title: English Practice Quiz 0979
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A 'meticulous' person pays attention to ___.
questions.explanation: Meticulous means very careful and attentive to detail.

questions.question: To 'mitigate' a risk is to ___.
questions.explanation: Mitigate means make something less harmful or serious.

questions.question: An 'ambiguous' statement is ___.
options: open to more than one interpretation
written in a foreign alphabet only
questions.explanation: Ambiguous wording can be understood in different ways.

questions.question: A 'plausible' explanation is one that ___.
questions.explanation: Plausible means appearing reasonable or likely.

questions.question: The word 'inevitable' describes something that ___.
questions.explanation: Inevitable means certain to happen or unavoidable.

questions.question: To 'scrutinise' a document is to ___.
questions.explanation: Scrutinise means inspect closely and critically.

questions.question: A 'coherent' argument is ___.
questions.explanation: Coherent ideas connect logically and clearly.

questions.question: The manager's decision was 'provisional', meaning it was ___.
questions.explanation: Provisional describes an arrangement that may be changed later.

questions.question: To 'endorse' a proposal means to ___.
questions.explanation: Endorse means express support or approval.

questions.question: A 'discrepancy' is a ___.
questions.explanation: A discrepancy is a mismatch between details or records.
